pins.name: D7
pins.label: GPIO7 (Button)
pins.notes: PIN_BUTTON / BOOT — onboard bootloader-select pushbutton, also usable as a general input when application code is running. Active-low with the RP2040's internal pull-up enabled (no external pull-up on this line). Confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_canbus_rp2040.dts gpio_keys node (gpios = <&gpio0 7 (GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW | GPIO_PULL_UP)>) and Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("Boot button is the button on the right, located on GPIO7"). Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output capability retained (ordinary GPIO wired to a switch to GND, not a dedicated/capacitive-only pin), matching this repo's adafruit_feather_scorpio PIN_BUTTON precedent.

pins.name: D13
pins.label: GPIO13 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED — onboard status LED, active-high. Confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_canbus_rp2040.dts leds node (gpios = <&gpio0 13 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>), consistent with Adafruit's own pinouts guide describing it as controllable via board.LED/digital pin 13. digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins (rpipico, adafruit_feather_scorpio); pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2040 GPIO, enabling brightness dimming. This GPIO was also the vendor's default (unused) PIN_SPI0_SS alias, which would have contaminated this confirmed LED tag with a spurious spi_ss capability — fixed 2026-07-13 by removing that alias from pins_arduino.h (the onboard CAN transceiver uses its own dedicated PIN_CAN_CS on GPIO19, not this default SS assignment), matching the adafruit_feather_scorpio audit's bus-alias-contamination fix pattern.

pins.name: D20
pins.label: D20 (GPIO20)
pins.notes: NEOPIXEL_POWER — onboard NeoPixel power-enable gate, must be driven HIGH for the status NeoPixel (GPIO21) to be powered. Not general-purpose. Confirmed via Adafruit's pinouts guide ("NeoPixel power pin on GPIO20. It needs to be set High for the NeoPixel to be powered"), matching this repo's ESP32 Feather/QT Py NEOPIXEL_POWER exclusion precedent (adafruit_feather_esp32s3, adafruit_qtpy_esp32s3_nopsram, etc.).

pins.name: D21
pins.label: GPIO21 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line, active-high. Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("Status NeoPixel LED. It is connected to GPIO21") and Zephyr's adafruit_feather_canbus_rp2040.dts ws2812 node (gpios = <&gpio0 21 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>). Requires NEOPIXEL_POWER (GPIO20) driven HIGH to actually light — see that pin's note.
